steps.speaker: Female Voice on Radio
steps.content: Hmm, you've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.

steps.speaker: Female Voice on Radio
steps.content: If you want, you can do it too.
Ah... I remember now. I think she said that...
But my voice, the one she's praised, can only be lost in the voices of those people, in their demands...
It's okay, we've found it... the voice I want most...
It's him. I've always known it, from the first time I called him~
steps.female_content: It's her. I've always known it, from the first time I called her~

steps.content: The most important, authentic voice that I've lost and long to retrieve... is a gentle and beautiful voice... It's the one you've always used with me...
Ding-a-ling...
In the darkness, the ringing of the phone pinches your nerves.
Reflexively, you open your eyes wide and breathe shallowly.
The violent heartbeats in your chest almost drown out the ringtone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My dear...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Finally... we get to meet... you...
A cold voice from the receiver tickles your eardrum. Shivering all over, you immediately drop the receiver and walk out of the phone booth.

The sky is covered in a hue red as the shackles, completely shrouding the streets of Eastside. The atmosphere is even more unsettling than the previous two worlds combined. Strange noises whisper in your ears ceaselessly, echoing in your mind.
You're clearly on your own, but you hear Eleven's voice.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why so nervous... I am right behind you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Behind me?
You turn to the phone booth. In that space that was empty just a moment ago, a woman stands.
She raises her head and stares straight at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you Eleven?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why do you call me that? I don't like it.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The program, its content, my look, and even my voice... Everything must be done in their way. I must always listen to the audience or I'll get no listenership, or so they say...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Then, out of nowhere, came the urban legend about Ghost Calls...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: At first, I didn't pay attention to it, thinking that maybe... it would cool off...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But everyone became more and more invested in it and my show gained a lot of traction... This was not my intention... and I hated it...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah, right, you taught me this... to know when to say "no"...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Call me by my name, please. Call me... Eleven.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Of course I am! But... indeed, not entirely...

Eleven in the phone booth picks up the receiver. You notice that all the speakers on the street seem to be connected to that receiver. Countless overlapping breathing sounds close in on you, rendering you almost breathless.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thank you... If you hadn't been... so nice to me... and said so many kind words along the way, I wouldn't have remembered why I chose this job...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Once... the voices I heard at 3 a.m... were really kind...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Just like yours~

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The words all of you utter are complimentary, admiring, kind, and full of love...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: That's what I pursue ultimately...!
Something seems to stir the power of Mania. It starts to churn and compress, rushing straight toward you!
You realize that in Eleven's mind, the words you've said to help her retrieve her voice have now all become what motivates and fuels her!
This is even more twisted than Call at 3 AM!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shouldn't you return to the real world after finding your voice?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What are you doing now?!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Can't you tell...? This is the power you've given me. You've granted me the voice I desired most!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thank you for showing me what a wonderful world it is when it's full of such voices!!!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The voices I received before were still not good enough... not enough to please me and bring me joy...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What I want is a world like this!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: A world constructed of your voice.
Your vision seems to freeze abruptly. The phone booth and Eleven have gone still before your eyes.
Unnervingly, you hear the sound of something being ripped, and a crack immediately emerges over your sight!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Come... Come on...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: All the worlds have merged. We've gathered enough power now...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You will stay here forever, and a new world will be born from your voice. I will create a world filled only with your beautiful voice...! This is... the voice I long for, the voice I want to hear and own in my dreams!
